Bluey Clothes, Toys, and More!

Let your imagination run wild and join Bluey and friends on an epic adventure! You'll never have to leave Bluey's side with our range of toys which includes Bluey dolls and playhouses. Keep the story going into the evening with a Bluey book, perfect for bedtime just like our Bluey pyjamas. Explore the full Bluey range today!


Bluey Clothes: Fun Meets Fashion

Bring the world of Bluey to life with our vibrant and fun range of Bluey clothes. Whether it's a themed t-shirt for a play date or Bluey PJs for a cosy night in, our clothing options allow your little ones to take their favourite characters with them wherever they go.


Bluey Toys: Imaginative Playtime Awaits

Delve into our exciting collection of Bluey toys, designed to encourage creative play and storytelling. Each toy, from interactive playsets to character figurines, brings the animated series to life, keeping your child engaged in endless fun.


Create Your Own Adventure with Bluey Playset

Our Bluey playset collection is perfect for creative play, inspiring kids to recreate their favourite scenes or invent brand-new stories. Designed with attention to detail and crafted for durability, these playsets are a wonderful addition to any playroom.


Bluey Plush Toys: Snuggle Up with Your Favourite Characters

There's nothing like a cuddly friend to comfort and soothe, and our Bluey plush toys are perfect for the job. Soft, adorable, and built to last, they're perfect for both playtime adventures and night-time cuddles!


Stay Cosy with Bluey PJs

Make bedtime exciting with our range of Bluey PJs. Designed for comfort and fun, these pyjamas bring your child's favourite characters into their dreams. From vibrant prints to soft materials, getting ready for bed has never been so enjoyable.


Discover our Bluey Range Today!

From day to night, playtime to bedtime, our Bluey range ensures that your child can always enjoy the company of their favourite characters. Shop the collection at Target Australia today and let your child's imagination soar with Bluey, Bingo, Bandit, and all their friends!
